title: Add New Command to alexANTria
description: Design and document a new command following alexANTria patterns
prompt: Design a new command called '/ant-status' that shows the current state of the alexANTria installation: which files exist, validation status, recent commits with ANT updates, and suggested next actions. Follow the existing command patterns in user-level/commands/.
success_criteria: Includes frontmatter with description and allowed-tools
References relevant ANT layers (Strategy, Patterns, etc.)
